name: NovaStar Splicer

actions.name: Select Screen
actions.description: Select/Deselect a screen (without affecting operations performed on other terminals).

options.label: Screen Select
options.choicesNote: Filled at runtime from the device screen list (R0400): one choice per screen, id = screenId (number), label = screen name. In offline programming mode the module synthesizes ids 0 to screenCount-1 labelled 'Screen N'. The source default is the first screen id, or null while the list is empty.

actions.name: Select Layer
actions.description: Select a layer (screen and layer display, without affecting operations performed on other terminals).

options.label: Screen Layer
options.choicesNote: Filled at runtime from the screens' layer lists: id is the string '<screenId>_<layerId>' (both numbers), label '<screen name>_<layer name>'. Offline programming mode synthesizes 4 layers per screen (layerId 0-3). The source default is the first entry or null.

actions.name: Preset
actions.description: Read the screen list and preset list of each screen. Preset loading is allowed.

options.label: Preset
options.choicesNote: Filled at runtime from the screens' preset lists: id is the string '<screenId>_<presetId>' (both numbers), label '<screen name>_<preset name>'. Offline programming mode synthesizes 20 presets per screen (presetId 0-19). The source default is the first entry or null.

actions.name: Send Command
actions.description: You can send a custom command. The text is sent as given (Buffer.from(command)); the source default is a JSON command array such as [{"cmd":"W041A","screenId":1,"enable":0}] (DEFAULT_COMMAND in utils/constant.js).

actions.name: Preset group
actions.description: Read the preset group list of the selected screen. Select a preset group to load it. (Once loaded, the screen with presets saved in the preset group is selected.

options.label: Preset Collection
options.choicesNote: Filled at runtime from the device preset group (preset collection) list: id = presetCollectionId as delivered by the device (type not fixed in the source), label = group name. Offline programming mode leaves the list empty. The source default is the first entry or null.

actions.name: PGM/PVW
actions.description: Switch to PGM/PVW mode for the selected screen. Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent.

actions.name: Take
actions.description: Press Take button to take the content to the screen in PVW mode. Only acts while PVW mode is active (set with pgm_pvw_switch). Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent.

actions.name: FTB
actions.description: On/Off; make the selected screen go black. Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent.

actions.name: Volume Switch
actions.description: On/Off; turn on or turn off the audio of the selected screen. Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent. The choice labels are 'open' (0) and 'close' (1); the value is sent as isMute.

actions.name: Screen FRZ
actions.description: On/Off; freeze the selected screen. Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent.

actions.name: Screen Volume Add
actions.description: Increase the volume of the selected screen (by 1, capped at 100). Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent.

actions.name: Screen Volume Minus
actions.description: Decrease the volume of the selected screen. Acts on the screens selected with select_screen (instance.selectedScreenList); without a selected screen nothing is sent.

actions.name: Brightness + (Direct)
actions.description: Increase brightness by 1% on a specific screen (no select_screen needed).

notes: Complete list: 27 actions (src/actions.js getActions) and 21 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.js getFeedbacks); both functions return one object literal and nothing is conditional on a model. The module also defines variables and presets (src/presets.js), which are not catalogued.

Dropdowns that depend on the device (screens, layers, presets, preset groups, input sources) are filled from the device lists at runtime (choicesNote); formatDropDownData in utils/formatDropDown.js builds them. The definitions are re-registered by updateAll() (src/main.js:285) after the lists are loaded. The source defaults of these dropdowns are the first list entry or null.

Screen ids are numbers; combined ids for layers and presets are strings '<screenId>_<layerId>' / '<screenId>_<presetId>' and source ids '<inputId>_<cropId>'. The callbacks compare the fixed dropdowns strictly: select_screen, take_switch and the other 0/1 dropdowns use number ids (1 and 0, not strings).

Protocol: JSON commands with 5-character codes (for example R0400, W0605, W0412; table ACTIONS_CMD in utils/constant.js) over UDP to the configured host and port (config fields host and port, source default port '6000'; src/main.js:349-352, 466). The host default in the source is a loopback example and is not recorded. An offline programming mode (config offlineMode, screenCount 1-40, inputCardCount 1-40) synthesizes screens, layers, presets and inputs and sends nothing.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.5.1 (1.x): options do not support expressions. The text input of set_brightness uses useVariables; the send_command text input has no useVariables.

Many actions work on the module-local selection (select_screen, select_layer) and do nothing when it is empty; the *_direct actions and feedbacks take the screen as an option and do not need a selection.

Upgrade script (src/upgrades.js) maps v2 ids: play_preset to load_preset, freeze to screen_frz_toggle, ftb to apply_ftb, brightness to screen_brightness_add; feedbacks freeze to screen_frz and ftb to ftb_selected. Option labels are written as both 'name:' and 'label:' in the source; the label is recorded.
Nothing in this file was tested against a device.
